claims.content: The system enables a VMU User to record a voucher sales return transaction when a distributor returns vouchers to the MSIU sales team by capturing mandatory details such as Distributor Name, Sales Man Name, Sales Return Date, Sales Return Amount, Number of vouchers Returned, Batch No, and Voucher No.

goal.raw_text: The system enables a VMU User to record a voucher sales return transaction when a distributor returns vouchers to the MSIU sales team by capturing mandatory details such as Distributor Name, Sales Man Name, Sales Return Date, Sales Return Amount, Number of vouchers Returned, Batch No, and Voucher No.

claims.content: VMU User
The Distributor Master must exist and contain at least one distributor record, as the Distributor Name field lists from this master.
The Sales Man Master must exist and contain at least one sales man record, as the Sales Man Name field lists from this master.
The VMU User must be logged into the system with appropriate permissions to access the Voucher Sales Return feature.
A distributor plans to return vouchers back to the MSIU sales team.

trigger.raw_text: A distributor plans to return vouchers back to the MSIU sales team.

claims.content: The VMU User accesses the Voucher Sales Return feature to record a return transaction.
The user selects the Distributor Name from the Distributor Master list.
The user selects the Sales Man Name from the Sales Man Master list.
The system defaults the Sales Return Date to the current system date, which the user can adjust provided it is not later than the system date.
The user enters the Number of vouchers Returned, Batch No, and Voucher No for the transaction part.
The system checks if the returned voucher was originally sold to the selected Distributor; if not, the system rejects the return.
The system automatically calculates the Sales Return Amount based on the number of vouchers returned multiplied by the wholesale rate.
The user saves the transaction, ensuring all mandatory fields are completed.
If the returned voucher was not originally sold to the selected Distributor, the system rejects the return and does not accept those vouchers.

The system has successfully recorded the voucher sales return transaction with all mandatory details captured: Distributor Name, Sales Man Name, Sales Return Date, Sales Return Amount, Number of vouchers Returned, Batch No, and Voucher No.
The Sales Return Amount has been automatically calculated as the product of the number of vouchers returned and the wholesale rate.
The system has verified that each returned voucher was originally sold to the selected distributor, ensuring only valid returns are accepted.
The Sales Return Date is set to a value less than or equal to the current system date, as enforced by the system's design constraints.
